problem.title: Great venues lose customers before the first conversation
problem.subtitle: Most customers decide who to contact after a few minutes online. Here is what usually gets in the way, and what changes.

noWebsite.solution: A branded website that reflects the quality of your venue.

photos.solution: A curated gallery with full-screen viewing.

packages.solution: Clear pages for spaces, rooms and packages.

repeated.problem: The same questions, again and again
repeated.solution: Answers, capacities and facilities are published up front.

inquiries.problem: Inquiries get lost in calls and chats
inquiries.solution: One structured inquiry form with all details included.

availability.problem: Customers cannot see which dates are open
availability.solution: An availability calendar that shows free and unavailable dates.

how.title: From your details to your first inquiry

one.title: Share your venue details
one.desc: Send us your photos, spaces, packages, contact details and the languages you need.

two.title: Get a customized website
two.desc: We design your website using your branding, in the languages your customers speak.

three.title: Start receiving inquiries
three.desc: Customers explore your venue, check dates and contact you by form or WhatsApp.

pricing.title: Choose the plan that fits your venue
pricing.subtitle: Every project is scoped together. The final scope, price and timeline are agreed with you before work begins.
pricing.note: Prices shown are samples or "contact for pricing". Hosting, domain names, payment processing and online booking are not included unless agreed in writing.

starter.name: Starter
starter.desc: A professional online presence for smaller venues.

professional.name: Professional
professional.desc: A complete showcase with packages and inquiries.

premium.name: Premium
premium.desc: Everything, plus tools to manage inquiries.

what.a: It gives hotels and event venues a professional multilingual website where customers can explore facilities, see packages and send inquiries.

custom.a: You share your photos, text and details. We apply your branding and content, so the site looks like your business and not a template.

inquiries.a: Customers send a request with their preferred date and details. It is an inquiry, not a confirmed reservation. Your team replies and confirms directly.

whatsapp.q: Can customers contact us on WhatsApp?
whatsapp.a: Yes. A WhatsApp button opens a chat with your number and a prepared message in the customer's language.

languages.a: English, Arabic, Dari and Pashto, with correct right-to-left layouts. Venue content can be written in each language.

mobile.q: Does it work on mobile phones?
mobile.a: Yes. Every page is designed for phones first and works on tablets and computers.

maintenance.a: Maintenance and updates can be arranged as an ongoing support option. The details are agreed per project.

future.a: Planned: secure owner accounts, real availability, online reservations and a marketplace of venues. These are not available yet.
